formats.result: The detached cached dependency stayed in the watcher graph. Its v2 edit triggered same-invocation restart, clearing the CommonJS cache before reimport loaded v2.

reason: Quench does not yet evict unreachable module records from both module caches coherently. Detached cached modules remain watched; if one changes with no active importer boundary, the update requests restart so a later reimport cannot execute stale source.
limitation: When a detached module changes, its later reimport requires a process restart, which resets session state. The accepted importer update that detached it remains in-process.
